sources.title: Babaji's YouTube channel
sources.method: Public channel feed (newest 15). With a free YouTube Data API key in the YOUTUBE_API_KEY secret, the whole upload history.
sources.publish: Published automatically; theme links start as automatic and are reviewed on the Review page.
sources.terms: Videos are embedded with YouTube's privacy-enhanced player and link back to YouTube.

sources.title: Gurmatveechar.com, Babaji's katha folder
sources.method: Reads the public folder listings once a day, one page per second, and records each recording's upload date once.
sources.publish: Published automatically; theme links are reviewed on the Review page.
sources.terms: Audio streams from Gurmatveechar, which hosts it, and is credited on every page. Nothing is copied.

sources.title: Programmes (Google Sheet)
sources.method: A Google Sheet published as CSV, set as programmes_csv_url in config.json.
sources.publish: Published automatically; past programmes drop off.

sources.title: BaniDB (Gurbani check)
sources.method: Checks each quoted Gurbani line against its Ang in the BaniDB API (Khalis Foundation). Only the result is stored.
sources.publish: Lines marked for verification stay hidden until they pass.

sources.title: Facebook page
sources.method: Meta Graph API with a Page access token (pages_read_engagement), granted by a page admin.
sources.note: Not connected until a Page admin adds FACEBOOK_PAGE_ID and FACEBOOK_PAGE_TOKEN; see docs/SOURCES.md. Imported posts wait for approval.
